finding.text: The new page /framework/ext/Chat/list/ can't be reached from navigation: `ext/Chat/page.js` still declares `children: "panel drill v2 v3"`, with no `list` (navigation 1, CLAUDE.md law 10, "index everything").

`Servex/agents/ChatWriter.js` is not in Servex/readme.md's `agents/` row, which lists every sibling (WakePolicy.js, page_tools.js…). A fresh agent reading Servex's index won't find the writer of the chat list (law 9).

`Server/ChatToMessages.mjs`, the migration script that has been written but not run, is not in `Server/doc/scripts.md`, the table of every Server script. A later agent asked to "run the migration" has to find it by grep.

`Servex/doc/item-tool.md` is now out of date. A read of a session (`item({path})`) also answers `messages: {count, last}`, and `messages`/`sentences` are new session keys (page_tools.js SESSION_KEYS), but the doc says neither. Only core/Session/Chat/readme.md mentions it.

Ask 2's "`{place}` edits update a message's text in place" is not met. The `{place}` lines are not mirrored. The Chat readme says so and says why (the fast seat is off by default since 2026-11-01). The item-tool path `{messages:{<id>:{title,text}}}` is built and tested, so this is a gap only if the fast seat comes back. Record that choice in the owner's decisions, not only in the readme.

The chat list shrinks to fit its widest bubble instead of filling the text column (sizing). At 400, the bubbles run from x≈82 to 428 while the paragraph above runs from 28 to 478: about a quarter of a phone's width is lost. At 1200, the list is ≈440px wide and centred under a ≈700px paragraph. Its width will jump as longer messages arrive (shots/…Chat-list/400.png and 1200.png, band 3 `chatlist`). Give `.chatlist` `width: 100%` (it already has max-width 46rem).

The "system" label on a note is almost unreadable (colour). It is 60% of 65% currentColor at .75em × .85em, roughly 2.5:1 on the page grey (400.png, the "system" label above "The smart assistant could not be reached").
Both shots logged a 404 (layout.json `errors`). Something the page loads is missing. Find what before merging.

The intro paragraph is written for a coder, not for the owner (content): "Servex/agents/chat-messages.test.mjs", "?src=<url of any session.jsonl>". Lead with one plain sentence ("This is a session's chat, drawn from its message list; it updates live") and move the `?src=` tip into the readme. The "clean" in "smart assistant · clean" is not explained either.

Class pages: Message, Prompt, Reply, Sentence and Chat are new classes. The demo shows live instances as bubbles but not their properties (id, `re.to`, `sentences`). A properties toggle on ChatList would satisfy "Show the class, and its live instances".
Known gap, written down in the readme: a reply that is held back while Servex restarts is lost from the list (V1 still keeps it). This is acceptable for now.
